companies.description: Kiewit Corp. is a leading construction and engineering company known for handling complex infrastructure, industrial, and energy projects. The company provides construction and design engineering services across markets such as transportation, power, building, mining, and water/wastewater. Its customers include government entities, private developers, and industrial companies seeking innovative and sustainable project solutions focused on safety, quality, and long-term collaboration.
companies.name: Kiewit Corp.

companies.description: Wesco International is a global distributor of electrical, electronic and communications products and provider of supply chain services. They sell primarily to businesses across construction, utilities, manufacturing, telecommunications and institutional sectors, offering product distribution plus procurement, inventory management, kitting, logistics and value-added fabrication and repair services. They position themselves as a comprehensive distribution and supply chain partner combining a broad product range with logistics and technical support services.
companies.name: Wesco International, Inc.

companies.description: Southwire Company, LLC. manufactures and supplies electrical wire, cable, and related electrical products for construction, industrial, and utility customers. They serve electrical contractors, distributors, utilities, and manufacturers and market themselves as a comprehensive source of wiring products and installation accessories supported by distribution and technical services.
companies.name: Southwire Company, LLC.

companies.description: designs and manufactures a comprehensive line of transformer solutions for the generation, transmission, and distribution of electrical energy. Prolec GE offers products including distribution, power, and renewable energy transformers, as well as specialized components and services like installation, testing, and maintenance. Its customers consist of utility companies, industrial plants, data centers, and renewable energy providers throughout the Americas and in more than 35 countries.
companies.name: Prolec Energy

companies.description: GEP is a leading provider of procurement and supply chain solutions, offering a wide range of products and services including consulting, software, and managed services. Their typical customers are large enterprises across various industries, including manufacturing, retail, healthcare, and financial services. GEP Worldwide claims to differentiate themselves through their comprehensive, unified procurement and supply chain platform, which they market as a single, cloud-native solution for all procurement and supply chain needs.
companies.name: GEP
